row: Goat Daddy's is a Grade A Goat Dairy, 501c3 animal sanctuary, and Airbnb located in central South Carolina. Nubian and Nigerian Dwarf goats make up the herd of nearly 60 goats and their high butterfat and eager browsing habits are what give the cheese its phenomenal taste. In addition to being a farm, Goat Daddy’s has worked with local vets, DNR, and rescues over the years and aided in providing a forever home to a plethora of animal species ranging from avian, camelid, equine, and reptiles.
